about: The City of North Vancouver is a compact waterfront city on Burrard Inlet, distinct from the much larger District of North Vancouver that surrounds it. Lower Lonsdale and the former shipyards form a dense urban core facing downtown Vancouver, with SeaBus service across the harbour. Mountain parks such as Grouse and Lynn Canyon lie in the District, not in this city. About 58,000 people live in the City of North Vancouver.
seoSummary: Compact North Shore city on Burrard Inlet, centred on Lonsdale Quay and the shipyards—not the District.
